visionWindow.subtitle: The source stays on the left, the main result stays on the right, and follow-up remains optional.
visionWindow.stageHint: Click the image to zoom. Use fit or 100% to inspect small text and UI details.
visionWindow.resultHint: The first streamed answer will settle here once the model finishes analyzing the image.
visionWindow.resultPinnedHint: The first result stays pinned here. Follow-up replies appear below.
visionWindow.readyHint: The main analysis will appear here as one continuous reading surface instead of several helper cards.
visionWindow.generatingHint: Reading the image and organizing the main result.
visionWindow.errorHint: The request did not complete successfully. Check the endpoint, model, and runtime state, then retry.
visionWindow.emptyResult: The model returned an empty response.
visionWindow.followupHint: Keep the current analysis as context and ask one focused follow-up.
visionWindow.threadHint: Only follow-up exchanges appear here. The primary result stays pinned above.

locale.label: Application language

launchOnStartup.help: Launch Clipboard God automatically when you sign in to your system.

llm.title: LLM Integrations
llm.description: Configure named LLM entries used by the AI tools.
llm.sectionSwitcherHelp: Use these tags to switch between the dedicated VLM image-action config and the separate named LLM preset area.

sectionDescriptions.vision: Manage the shared vision model config used by the screenshot toolbar, OCR window, and built-in image actions.
sectionDescriptions.entries: Manage independent text/image LLM presets that stay separate from the built-in VLM actions.

llm.visionHelp: Image actions in the OCR window and screenshot toolbar reuse this dedicated vision model config instead of mixing it into OCR engine settings.
llm.visionTagsHelp: These tags only change the vision model used by the built-in image actions above.
llm.visionActionHint: These built-in image actions use the vision model config above directly, so OCR no longer keeps a separate VL config block.
llm.entriesHelp: General text/image LLM entries still live here; the built-in vision buttons above do not share this list.
llm.textTagsHelp: These tags only change the model used by the current text LLM entry.
llm.imageTagsHelp: These tags only change the model used by the current image LLM entry.
llm.ollamaInputHelp: Pick a detected Ollama model from the list or type one manually.
llm.ollamaModelListUnavailable: No Ollama model list is available yet. You can still type a model name manually.
llm.modelTagConfirmedTooltip: Recognized as a confirmed vision model.
llm.modelTagCandidateTooltip: Possible vision family or fallback display item. Verify the exact model tag before using image actions.

entryName.label: Entry name (select or type)
entryName.placeholder: Choose or enter a name, e.g. Note1

llm.triggerHelp: Choose the trigger type. Text triggers use {{text}} in the prompt; image triggers will send the screenshot as input.
llm.shortcutPlaceholder: Set a shortcut for this entry (optional)
llm.shortcutHelp: Set an entry-specific shortcut to trigger this LLM via the global hotkey.
llm.paramsCollapsed: Parameters are collapsed. Click to expand for edit.
llm.saveNote: All entries are written back to config on save.

ocr.title: OCR
ocr.toolWindowHint: Changes here stay local to this window until you choose Save and apply.
ocr.toolWindowSaved: OCR settings saved and applied to global config.
ocr.toolWindowDirty: These edits stay in this window until you save and apply them.
ocr.toolWindowAppliedTitle: Current config has been applied globally
ocr.toolWindowDraftFooter: Changes are broadcast to the main window and OCR window only after Save and apply.
ocr.toolWindowAppliedFooter: This is the unified detached settings workbench.
ocr.closeDiscardConfirm: There are unapplied changes in this window. Close and discard them?
ocr.openToolWindowHelp: Tune PaddleOCR-VL runtime, worker-pool, and text-layout parameters in a detached window instead of squeezing them into the OCR result window.
ocr.rocmHint: For AMD / ROCm GPUs, point the CLI command to a Python or virtualenv that has the ROCm-enabled PaddlePaddle build installed, then use device `gpu:0`.
ocr.runtimeTargetHelp: Choose which runtime family the detector should prefer when it scans OCR environments on this machine.
ocr.runtimeSummaryHelp: The detector inspects the current OCR CLI, local Python environments, and host hardware such as ROCm.
ocr.runtimeSummaryEmpty: No OCR runtime detection has been run yet.
ocr.runtimeInstallCommandsHelp: Run these commands in a terminal, then use re-detect to switch the app to the new environment.
ocr.runtimeRedetectApplied: OCR runtime re-detected and the command path was written back to global config.
ocr.runtimeRedetectNoChange: OCR runtime re-detected. The current command already matches the best detected environment.
ocr.currentSummaryRuntime: Current runtime: command={{command}}, device={{device}}, CPU threads={{cpuThreads}}, concurrent jobs={{jobs}}
ocr.languageTagHelp: These tags control regular OCR language selection. The PaddleOCR-VL language family below only applies when the external CLI backend is enabled.
ocr.languageTagEmpty: Keep at least one language selected
ocr.modelSourceHelp: Use the built-in PP-OCRv5 model or a locally installed PaddleOCR-VL CLI backend.
ocr.modelLanguageHelp: Choose the language family used by the local PaddleOCR-VL CLI backend.
ocr.modelLanguageDisabledHelp: This language family is only applied when model source is set to PaddleOCR-VL (local CLI).
ocr.modelSectionActiveHelp: You are configuring the external PaddleOCR-VL CLI backend. Save and apply to write both the model source and language family together.
ocr.modelSectionInactiveHelp: You are currently using the built-in OCR engine. The PaddleOCR-VL language family below only matters after switching to the external CLI backend.
ocr.modelLanguageActiveOverview: External CLI language family is active
ocr.vlCliCommandHelp: Default is `paddleocr`. Point this to your virtualenv executable if the command is not on PATH; for AMD / ROCm or CUDA GPU use, point it at the matching GPU-enabled environment. If left generic, the app also searches common local `.venv-paddleocr-vl` locations automatically.
ocr.vlDeviceHelp: Leave blank to let PaddleOCR choose automatically. Auto only uses GPU when the selected environment has a GPU-enabled PaddlePaddle build with the required CUDA or ROCm runtime. You can also enter `cpu`, `gpu:0`, or `gpu:0,1`.
ocr.vlCpuThreadsHelp: Controls how many threads a single CPU inference uses. Values above 0 are passed as `--cpu_threads`; use 0 to let Paddle decide.
ocr.vlMaxConcurrentJobsHelp: How many PaddleOCR-VL tasks may run at the same time in the main process. Each task still uses its own CPU thread count, so setting this too high can oversubscribe the machine.
ocr.vlEnableMkldnnHelp: CPU inference acceleration. It is mainly useful for CPU mode and mostly irrelevant on GPU.
ocr.vlCliArgsHelp: Optional arguments appended after `paddleocr doc_parser`, for example `--device cpu` or `--engine transformers`.
ocr.docOrientationHelp: Rotate documents to the correct orientation before OCR.
ocr.textlineOrientationHelp: Rotate upside-down text lines before recognition.
ocr.insertSpaceByGapHelp: Insert a space when the gap between boxes is large.
ocr.splitByGapHelp: Split a large box into smaller ones when there is a big blank gap.
ocr.lineMergeThresholdRatioHelp: Larger values keep more words on the same line.
ocr.lineMergeThresholdPxHelp: Minimum pixel threshold to keep words on the same line.
ocr.spaceGapMinPxHelp: Minimum pixel gap to insert a space.
